title: PGSA Maritime Compliance & Secondary Exposure
monitoring_question: Is the PGSA regime expanding from direct designations into enforceable secondary commercial exposure?
indicators: New designations; enforcement; delistings; STS counterparties; owner/operator changes; future Hormuz passage
trigger_threshold: Confirmed enforcement against listed/counterparty vessel or material list expansion
notes: Core P&C Intelligence watch; also feeds Trade System exposure.

title: East Asia Official MARSEC Incident Watch
monitoring_question: Are official coast-guard incidents indicating material commercial-vessel or port disruption?
indicators: Grounding; collision; fire; rescue; pollution; channel restriction; fatalities
trigger_threshold: Commercial vessel casualty or disruption to tracked port/corridor

title: India MARSEC Casualty & Pollution Watch
monitoring_question: Are Indian casualty/SAR/pollution events affecting tracked maritime infrastructure or trade?
indicators: Grounding; fire; loss of stability; spill; port restriction; investigation circular
trigger_threshold: Merchant casualty with material trade, port or pollution consequence
notes: Use ICG for operations and DG Shipping for regulatory follow-up.

title: Hormuz Commercial Access Under PGSA
monitoring_question: Is PGSA enforcement changing actual commercial access or counterparty behavior in Hormuz?
indicators: Transit counts; avoided fixtures; STS transfers; detention/diversion; delisting requests
trigger_threshold: Confirmed repeat enforcement or sustained traffic change
notes: Designed to bridge compliance and trade behavior.

title: PGSA Enforcement Activity
monitoring_question: Has the regime moved from designation to physical enforcement?
indicators: Warnings; boarding; inspection; detention; diversion; cargo action
trigger_threshold: One confirmed enforcement action raises status; repeated actions escalate further
notes: Baseline initially assumes limited verified enforcement.
